title: Senior Technical Lead / Architect
jobDescription:
We are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking Senior Technical Lead / Architect to drive the design, evolution, and delivery of our requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions. You will work closely with product, infrastructure, and data teams to establish best practices across the full software delivery lifecycle. You are equally comfortable whiteboarding system designs with architects as you are reviewing pull requests with developers. Your technology background is broad and stack-agnostic; what matters most is your depth of engineering judgement and your passion for building systems that last. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Architecture & Design ● Lead end-to-end architecture for new products, platforms, and major feature initiatives ● Define and maintain reference architectures, design patterns, and coding standards across teams ● Evaluate build vs. buy decisions and drive technology selection with clear rationale ● Produce architectural decision records (ADRs) and ensure documentation stays current ● Design for non-functional requirements: scalability, resilience, observability, and security by design Technical Leadership ● Provide hands-on technical mentorship to senior, mid, and junior engineers ● Conduct architecture and code reviews with constructive, knowledge-sharing feedback ● Collaborate with product owners to refine technical feasibility, effort estimates, and trade-off analysis ● Act as the primary technical point of contact for cross-team and cross-functional initiatives Cloud & Infrastructure ● Design and govern cloud-native architectures on AWS, Azure, and/or GCP (multi-cloud awareness is a plus) ● Define cloud cost optimisation strategies — right-sizing, reserved capacity, and Fin Ops principles ● Ensure architectures leverage managed services, serverless patterns, and auto-scaling where appropriate ● Drive Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) adoption using tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, or CDK Database Engineering ● Design and own relational (Postgre SQL, SQL Server, My SQL) and No SQL (Mongo DB, Dynamo DB, Redis, Cassandra) schemas ● Lead database performance optimisation: query tuning, indexing strategies, execution plan analysis, and caching layers ● Define data security controls: encryption at rest and in transit, field-level masking, RBAC, and audit logging ● Govern data lifecycle policies, backup/recovery strategies, and disaster recovery testing ● Evaluate and introduce new storage technologies aligned to specific workload demands Dev Ops & Developer Experience ● Champion CI/CD pipeline design, branching strategies, and automated testing gates ● Containerise applications using Docker and oversee Kubernetes / ECS / Cloud Run deployment models ● Promote shift-left security (SAST, DAST, dependency scanning) within the development workflow ● Establish SLOs, error budgets, and observability practices using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or equivalent AI & Emerging Technologies (Advantageous) ● Contribute architectural guidance to AI/ML-powered product features or internal tooling ● Evaluate and integrate LLM APIs, embedding pipelines, RAG architectures, or fine-tuning workflows ● Ensure responsible AI practices — model governance, bias evaluation, and data privacy compliance ● Stay current with the AI landscape and identify opportunities to embed intelligent capabilities into products Show Less… Preferred Skills Core Engineering Experience ● 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in a technical lead or architect capacity ● Proficiency in one or more languages: Java Script/Type Script (Node.js), Python, Java, C# (.NET), or Go ● Solid grasp of OOP, functional programming, design patterns (SOLID, DDD, CQRS, Event Sourcing), and clean code principles ● Extensive experience designing RESTful and Graph QL APIs; familiarity with g RPC and async messaging (Kafka, Rabbit MQ, SQS) ● Proven track record of delivering large-scale distributed systems in production environments Cloud Platforms (at least one, multi-cloud awareness preferred) [AWS] [Azure] [Google Cloud Platform] ● Deep hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider ● Core service familiarity: compute (EC2/VMs/GCE), containers (EKS/AKS/GKE), serverless, object storage, CDN, VPC/networking ● Understanding of IAM, least-privilege access, secrets management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Key Vault) ● Experience with cloud cost management, tagging strategies, and rightsizing Database Skills (MANDATORY) [Schema Design] [Query Optimisation] [Indexing] [Security] [DR & Backup] ● Strong relational database design skills — normalisation, referential integrity, schema versioning (Flyway, Liquibase) ● Performance tuning: EXPLAIN/ANALYZE, index design, covering indexes, partitioning, connection pooling ● No SQL data modelling for document stores, key-value, wide-column, and time-series databases ● Database security: row-level security, column masking, audit trails, encryption key management ● High-availability configurations: read replicas, failover clusters, cross-region replication Dev Ops & Containerisation (Minimum Proficiency Required) [Docker] [CI/CD] [Ia C] [Kubernetes (basic)] ● Container fundamentals: Dockerfile best practices, multi-stage builds, image hardening, registry management ● CI/CD pipeline configuration in Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI, Azure Dev Ops, or Jenkins ● Infrastructure as Code basics with Terraform or equivalent ● Familiarity with Kubernetes concepts (deployments, services, config maps, ingress) — deep expertise is a plus Soft Skills & Leadership ● Exceptional communication — able to translate technical concepts for both engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders ● Strong analytical and systems-thinking approach to problem decomposition ● Experience driving technical roadmaps aligned with business goals and product strategy ● Comfortable operating in fast-paced, agile environments with shifting priorities ● Collaborative, empathetic leadership style with a focus on team growth and knowledge transfer NICE TO HAVE (ADVANTAGEOUS) ● Prior experience contributing to or leading AI/ML-powered products or platforms ● Hands-on work with LLM frameworks: Lang Chain, Llama Index, Open AI API, Azure Open AI, Vertex AI, or Bedrock ● Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector) and semantic search architectures ● MLOps experience: model deployment, versioning, monitoring, and retraining pipelines ● Knowledge of data engineering patterns — streaming (Kafka, Kinesis), batch ETL, and data lake/warehouse architectures ● Relevant cloud certifications: AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect ● Experience in regulated industries (Fin Tech, Health Tech, Gov Tech) with compliance awareness (GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2) ● Open-source contributions or active participation in technical communities Job Category: Project jobDescription:
What’s important to us: We are looking for a skilled and experienced Data Engineer with over 4 years of professional experience in

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design, build, and maintain end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines using both on-premise and cloud-based technologies. Architect and operate data storage and streaming solutions leveraging cloud-based services on AWS , Azure , or GCP . Design and implement data ingestion and transformation workflows using Airflow , AWS Glue , or Azure Data Factory . Develop and optimize data pipelines using Python and Py Spark for large-scale distributed data processing. Build data models — normalized, denormalized, and dimensional ( Star/Snowflake ) — for analytics and warehousing solutions. Implement data quality , lineage , and governance using metadata management and monitoring tools. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver clean, reliable, and timely data for analytics and machine learning use cases. Integrate CI/CD pipelines for data infrastructure deployment using Git Hub Actions , Jenkins , or Azure Dev Ops . Automate infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) tools such as AWS Cloud Formation or Terraform . Monitor and optimize data processing performance for scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency. Enforce data security policies and ensure compliance with standards such as GDPR and HIPAA . Must-Have Skills &

QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related field. Experience: Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience as a Data Engineer or in data-intensive environments. SQL Expertise: Advanced proficiency in SQL for complex queries, joins, window functions, and performance tuning. Analytical Databases: Experience working with Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, Google Big Query, Azure Synapse, and Postgre SQL . Query Optimization: Skilled in query optimization, indexing, and execution plan analysis for high-performance analytics workloads. Programming: Proficient in Python and Py Spark for data manipulation, automation, and pipeline orchestration. Data Processing Frameworks: Strong understanding of Apache Spark (RDD, Data Frame, Spark SQL, optimization), Hive, Hadoop, and Flink for large-scale distributed data processing. ETL/ELT Frameworks: Hands-on experience designing and maintaining pipelines using Airflow, AWS Glue, or Azure Data Factory. Data Integration Patterns: Familiar with incremental loading, Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD), Change Data Capture (CDC), and error handling in data pipelines. Data Modeling: Expertise in data modeling, schema design, and building normalized, denormalized, and dimensional ( Star/Snowflake ) schemas. Data Architecture: Strong understanding of Data Warehousing, Data Lakes, and Lakehouse architectures, including Delta Lake, ACID transactions, and partitioning strategies . Cloud Platforms: Practical experience with major cloud ecosystems — AWS: S3, Glue, Redshift, Athena, Lambda, Step Functions, EMR Azure: Data Factory, Data Lake Gen2, Synapse, Databricks Cloud Security: Experience managing IAM roles, access control, and encryption in cloud environments. Pipeline Optimization: Skilled in optimizing data pipelines for performance, scalability, and cost-efficiency. CI/CD and Dev Ops: Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools such as Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI, or Azure Dev Ops. Version Control: Proficient with Git and familiar with agile development practices. Good-to-Have Skills: Experience with containerization and orchestration . Exposure to data cataloging and governance tools . Experience with monitoring tools . Familiarity with data APIs and microservices architecture . Certification in cloud data engineering (e.g., AWS Certified Data Engineer, Azure Data Engineer Associate, or GCP Professional Data Engineer). Experience supporting machine learning and analytics pipelines . Soft Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset. Excellent communication and documentation skills. Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment. Strong attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy and reliability. Eagerness to learn and adopt emerging data technologies.
